Context: 4. Increments

Qualifying period for earning an increment is 6 months on 1st July.  
However, a Government servant who is promoted/appointed on 1st January of a year, joins that post on the first working day of the year due to Sunday or a Gazetted holiday falling on 1st January, is deemed to have completed six months of service on 1st July of that year for drawal of annual increment. - GIO (15), FR 26.
